lines.en: label yukispring3:
scene yukiatthedoor1
: Can you shut the fuck up about my tits?! It’s every fucking day with you! You literally never stop!
lines.zh: : 关于我的胸你能不能他妈闭嘴?!你他妈天天来这套!你 literally 从来不停!

lines.en: : Oh my fucking- fine! I’ll leave! She’s probably not fucking here anyway. I have a better chance of finding her passed out in a fucking alley somewhere.
lines.zh: : 哦我他————好!行!我走!她多半根本不在这儿。我去别的什么他妈小巷里找她昏倒的,把握还大一点。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor2
: Oh — and if I do, I’ll fucking kill her myself. Mark my fucking words. Stupid piece of shit fucking worthless mother! Fuck!
lines.zh: : 哦——真让我找到了,我就亲手杀了她。记住我的话。又蠢又没用的贱货妈妈!操!

lines.en: Yuki Yamaguchi could do little more than let her cigarette burn as she sat there, pressed against the wall and listening to the footsteps of her daughter fade away.
lines.zh: 山口雪能做的,不过任由指间的香烟烧下去。她坐在那里,背靠着墙,听着女儿的脚步声渐渐远去。

lines.en: At first, she wanted to talk to her. She wanted to try and explain things or apologize or...really just do anything but vanish.
lines.zh: 起初,她想追上去。她想试着解释,或者道歉,或者……真的做任何事,只要不是消失。

lines.en: But upon reflection, she understood that vanishing was what would be best for the girl. And that reappearing at all was a mistake.
lines.zh: 但转念一想,她明白,消失才是对那孩子最好的。而重新出现,本身就是个错误。

lines.en: She should have never come back. She should have died, passed out in a fucking alley somewhere, just like her daughter said.
lines.zh: 她根本不该回来。她应该像女儿说的那样,死掉,昏倒在某个他妈小巷里。

lines.en: But old habits got the best of her and forced her to fight. To try and preserve the little bit of life she still clung to.
lines.zh: 可旧习难改,它逼着她挣扎。逼她去守住自己仅剩的那一点生命。

lines.en: In that context, fighting meant turning things around. It meant getting clean — sifting through countless trash bins to find the puzzle pieces that fell from her pockets on laps around the city.
lines.zh: 在那样的语境下,「挣扎」意味着扭转人生。意味着戒毒——意味着翻遍无数个垃圾桶,去捡回绕城跑圈时从口袋里掉落的碎片。

lines.en: She remembers the wind in her hair. She remembers the lights. God, she loved those lights — and how they’d always guide her home, even when they were blurred by the speed of her bike.
lines.zh: 她记得风穿过发丝的感觉。她记得那些灯。天,她爱死了那些灯——它们总能指引她回家,哪怕它们被摩托车的速度拉成模糊的光带。

lines.en: Nowadays, everything was blurry — a side effect of pumping every illicit substance she could find into her body to try and shock it back to life.
lines.zh: 如今,一切都模糊了——那是往身体里灌注所有能找到的违禁药物、试图电击复活的副作用。

lines.en: Gone were the days of fighting to live. Now, she just wanted to fight.
lines.zh: 「为活命而战」的日子一去不返。如今,她只是想战斗。

lines.en: And it didn’t matter what. It didn’t matter who. So she settled on fighting herself as a means of accelerating a long overdue punishment she’d always known would catch up to her.
lines.zh: 和什么斗都行。和谁都行。于是她选了和自己斗,以此加速那场她一直知道迟早会追上自己的、迟到已久的惩罚。

lines.en: scene black
She never thought it’d be like this, though.
lines.zh: 只是她从没想过会是这样。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor3
She takes another drag of her cigarette, unsure of what sort of effect its toxicity would have on her decaying physical form. But again, that didn’t matter much now.
lines.zh: 她又吸了一口烟,不确定它的毒性会对她腐坏的身体产生什么影响。但这眼下也不太重要了。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor4
: Hah...
The locks had been changed. Yumi’s number had been blocked. And she’d even taken the liberty of informing her neighbors that she didn’t want her daughter around here anymore.
lines.zh: 锁芯换过了。Yumi 的号码拉黑了。她甚至还自作主张地知会邻居,她不想再让女儿在这一带出没。

lines.en: Of course that raised questions — but people seldom questioned Yuki. Because even when she was in the wrong, which she so commonly was, she could sound like she wasn’t.
lines.zh: 这当然惹来了疑问——但人们很少质疑 Yuki。因为就算她理亏——她经常理亏——她也能把话说得像自己没错。

lines.en: A skill acquired to better get the things she wanted whenever she wanted them. And one not at all dissimilar from those who ran the same laps around the city.
lines.zh: 那是一门本事,是为了想要什么就能随时拿到什么而练出来的。和绕城跑圈的那些人,没什么两样。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor5
But still, there was one thing she wanted that she would deprive herself of — and it must have been halfway around the block by now.
lines.zh: 但有一样她想要的东西,她剥夺了自己的资格——而那样东西,此刻大概已经绕过了半条街。

lines.en: This could be the last time she ever heard her voice.
lines.zh: 这可能是她最后一次听见女儿的声音。

lines.en: It probably wouldn’t be. But it could be. And despite how accustomed she had become to thinking such a thing, it did little to numb the pain. That’s where the drugs came in.
lines.zh: 多半不是。但也可能是。尽管她已对这种想法习以为常,它却丝毫不能麻痹疼痛。于是药物登场。

lines.en: But even those were losing their luster. And Yuki was quickly learning that despite how good they could make her feel, they would never kill the fear of death.
lines.zh: 可连药物也在失去光泽。Yuki 很快学到:它们能让她感觉多好,却永远杀不死对死亡的恐惧。

lines.en: After thirty-eight years, she had finally run out of gas.
lines.zh: 三十八年过去,她的油箱终于见了底。

lines.en: And she would die in this room whether she liked it or not.
lines.zh: 无论愿不愿意,她都会死在这个房间里。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor6
She taps on a name in her phone and takes a sip from a potion she used to believe would grant her eternal life. Or at least it was something she would joke about when it was still fun to joke at all.
lines.zh: 她在手机上点开一个名字,啜饮一口那瓶她曾相信能赐予永恒生命的药剂。至少,当玩笑还有乐趣可言的时候,她常这么开玩笑。

lines.en: All things considered, alcohol was the least of her worries. It wasn’t her liver that was rotting, after all. That much she knew.
lines.zh: 综合考量,酒精是她最不用担心的一样。毕竟正在腐烂的又不是她的肝。这一点她清楚。

lines.en: But it didn’t change the fact that this very elixir was the same one that took the lives of girls she used to know before venturing off into the world alone.
lines.zh: 但这改变不了:正是这瓶灵药,夺走了她认识的女孩们的生命——后来,她们才各自只身闯荡世界。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor7
As the phone continued to ring, she remembered a friend who’d drink mouthwash when she couldn’t get her hands on alcohol.
lines.zh: 电话一遍遍响着,她想起一个朋友——搞不到酒的时候就喝漱口水。

lines.en: And as she, in her drunken stupor, kicked over a stack of cans that spilled violently onto a small bundle of hypodermic needles, she thanked herself for never being that pathetic.
lines.zh: 当她醉眼昏沉地踢翻一摞易拉罐,罐子哗啦啦砸在一小捆皮下注射针头上时,她感谢自己从没沦落到那样可悲。

lines.en: : Hel-
: ‘Bout fuckin’ time you picked up.
lines.zh: : 你他妈总算接了。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor8
: About time you called.
lines.zh: : 你总算打来了。

lines.en: : Guessing you’ve already heard the news then, huh? Fucking brat — sharing personal information with her goddamn teacher of all people.
lines.zh: : 我猜你已经听说消息了,嗯?小兔崽子——把个人信息告诉谁不好,偏偏告诉她妈的班主任。

lines.en: : Are you drunk?
lines.zh: : 你喝醉了?

lines.en: : I’m a whole fuckin’ bunch of things, Akira. Drunk is just one of ‘em.
lines.zh: : 我一堆毛病都占全了,Akira。醉只是其中之一。

lines.en: : Anyway, you still want to fuck me? So bored that I’m fuckin’ dying over here. Get it?
lines.zh: : 总之,你还想上我吗?我都无聊到快死了。懂这个梗吧?

lines.en: : That’s not funny, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 这一点也不好笑,Yuki。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor9
: Oh, would you fuckin’ grow a pair? Come on. That was a little funny. Admit it.
lines.zh: : 哦,你他妈能不能有点种?拜托。那有那么一丁点好笑。承认吧。

lines.en: : I disagree. But I’m sure I have at least one friend who would find it hilarious.
lines.zh: : 我不同意。不过我确信,我至少有一个朋友会觉得好笑。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Bring them over too. I’m fuckin’ everybody tonight. Gotta go out with a bang, you know?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗?那把他也带来。今晚我他妈谁来都上。总得轰轰烈烈地退场,你懂吧。

lines.en: : So you get cancer and...what? You just start using puns all the time?
lines.zh: : 所以你得了癌症,然后……怎么样?就开始不停说双关语了?

lines.en: : Who cares? You coming or not?
lines.zh: : 谁在乎?你到底来不来?

lines.en: : No, Yuki. I am not coming over there to fuck you. I’m pissed off at you for hiding this from me and even more pissed off that you think I’d overlook that just to get in your pants.
lines.zh: : 不,Yuki。我不会过去上你。你瞒着我这件事,我火大;你觉得我会为了上床睁一只眼闭一只眼,我更火大。

lines.en: : The fuck do you have to be mad about, huh? Yumi, I get. You, though? You’re just some random fucking guy. We don’t actually give a shit about each other, do we?
lines.zh: : 你他妈有什么好气的,嗯?Yumi 生气我懂。你呢?你不过是个随机的他妈路人。我们本来就互不在乎,不是吗?

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor10
: Hello? Helloooooooo?
: I’m trying not to hold it against you because I know you’re fucked up right now. But that hurt, Yuki. I really do care about you.
lines.zh: : 我尽量不跟你计较,因为我知道你现在很糟。但那句话伤到我了,Yuki。我是真的在乎你。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? Then name three good things about me. Go on. I’m listening.
lines.zh: : 哦是吗?那说出我的三个优点。来。我听着呢。

lines.en: : I don’t think I can, to be honest. You’re a pretty terrible person.
lines.zh: : 老实说,我说不出来。你是个相当糟糕的人。

lines.en: : Ha! Now THAT is funny!
lines.zh: : 哈!这个才他妈好笑!

lines.en: : There don’t need to be any good things about you for me to like you, though. For example, there’s nothing good about me and plenty of people like me.
lines.zh: : 不过,你不需要有任何优点,我也会喜欢你。比如说,我身上没有任何优点,照样一堆人喜欢我。

lines.en: : Well hey- that’s fuckin’ great, man. It’s really cool you’ve got a whole fuckin’ fan club and I’ve got god damn fucking Rika and that’s it.
lines.zh: : 嗯嘿——那可他妈太好了,老兄。你有一整个他妈粉丝团,而我只有天他妈的 Rika。就这样。

lines.en: : You had Sara too until you shat all over her. How’s that working out for you?
lines.zh: : 你本来还有 Sara,直到你把她糟蹋了个遍。那事进展如何?

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor11
: Fuckin’ horrible. I’m broke as shit now- which is actually the real reason I’m calling. Can you lend me some money for laundry? I’m outta clean clothes.
lines.zh: : 惨得他妈没边。现在我穷得叮当响——这才是我真正打电话来的原因。能借我点钱洗衣服吗?我没有干净衣服了。

lines.en: : How much do you need?
lines.zh: : 你要多少?

lines.en: : Hundred-grand maybe?
lines.zh: : 十万吧?

lines.en: : A hundred-thousand yen? You really expect me to believe you have that much laundry when I’ve only seen you wear a total of three outfits?
lines.zh: : 十万日元?你总共只有三套衣服,还指望我相信你有那么多要洗的?

lines.en: : Aww, you kept track? Tell you what — you come over now and I’ll let you fuck me in all three of them.
lines.zh: : 哎呀,你还记着账呢?这样吧——你现在过来,我让你三套都上。

lines.en: : I’m not lending you any money, Yuki. Not knowing what you’d use it for.
lines.zh: : 我不会借你任何钱,Yuki。不知道你拿去干什么。

lines.en: : Not even if I say it’s for hospital bills?
lines.zh: : 就算我说是付医疗费呢?

lines.en: : That’s what Yumi found, you know. She tell you that? Bitch ripped up the damn bill and left it in pieces all over the floor. Hell of a thing to come home to, you know.
lines.zh: : 那就是Yumi发现的东西,你知道吗。她跟你说了吗?那个贱人把账单撕了个粉碎,扔得满地都是。回家看到这个,够带劲的吧。

lines.en: : Like, it’s one thing to find out you’re dying. But not knowing what you owe on top of that? Man. Life’s fuckin-
lines.zh: : 就是说,发现自己要死了已经够惨了。结果连自己欠了多少都不知道?老天。人生真是他——

lines.en: : Are you actually dying, Yuki? Like...what...what is it, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你真的要死了吗,Yuki?就是……到底是什么?

lines.en: : Like, what kinda cancer? How long do I have? That what you want to know? You don’t want to be surprised?
lines.zh: : 比如,哪种癌?我还有多久?你想知道的是这个?你不想被吓一跳?

lines.en: : By you suddenly dying one day? Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 被你哪天突然死掉吓一跳?确实,不太想。

lines.en: : What if I told you I only have a week left?
lines.zh: : 要是我告诉你,我只剩一周了呢?

lines.en: : Yuki-
lines.zh: : Yuki——

lines.en: : Would you spend all of it with me?...Read me bedtime stories?...Hold me in those fuckin’ wimpy ass noodle arms of yours and kiss me on the forehead all cute-like?
lines.zh: : 你会把那一周全都陪我过完吗?……给我念睡前故事?……用你那两条软脚虾胳膊搂着我,温柔地亲我的额头?

lines.en: : Please don’t joke with me right now.
lines.zh: : 请别在这个时候跟我开玩笑。

lines.en: : What if it was a month? A year, even. How long could I get you to stay with me before you leave, Akira? Tell me. How long?
lines.zh: : 那要是还剩一个月呢?甚至一年。在你离开之前,我能留你留多久,Akira?告诉我。多久?

lines.en: : I’m not the one you really want by your side right now. We both know that.
lines.zh: : 你现在真正想要的那个陪在身边的人,不是我。我们都知道。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor12
: You need to talk to her, Yuki. She’s not taking it well.
lines.zh: : 你得去和她谈谈,Yuki。她承受得很不好。

lines.en: : She was...
: She was just here...a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 她刚才就在这儿……一会儿之前。

lines.en: : She was? So you talked to her then?
lines.zh: : 来过?那你们谈过了?

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor13
: No, I...kinda just sat up against the door and...didn’t do shit.
lines.zh: : 没有,我……就是靠着门坐着,然后……什么都没做。

lines.en: : She might’ve been with somebody? Was talkin’ to someone. Either that or I’m just high as fuck. Hell, maybe she was never here at all and I just hallucinated the whole damn thing?
lines.zh: : 她旁边可能还有人?她在和谁说话。要么就是,我只是 high 得他妈不轻。见鬼,也许她压根没来过,整件事都是我的幻觉?

lines.en: : Please talk to her. You owe her that much. And if things are really as bad as you’re making them sound-
lines.zh: : 去和她谈谈。你至少欠她这个。而且如果事情真有你说的那么糟——

lines.en: : I don’t..um...
: I don’t really know...how bad things are...exactly...
lines.zh: : 我其实不太清楚……事情到底……有多糟……

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor14
: ...What?
: Yeah...I had other appointments and like...follow-up shit scheduled, but...
lines.zh: : 是……我本来还有别的预约,还有……复诊什么的,但是……

lines.en: : I sort of just...didn’t go...
lines.zh: : 我就是……没去……

lines.en: : You...didn’t go...
: It’s in my lungs, Akira. Surprise, surprise.
lines.zh: : 是肺,Akira。惊喜吧,惊喜。

lines.en: : Yuki, what the fuck do you mean you didn’t go? How much do you know? Did they tell you how serious it is?
lines.zh: : Yuki,你说「没去」是什么意思?你知道多少?他们告诉你有多严重了吗?

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor15
: They can still do something, can’t they? I’ll go with you if you want. But if you sit back and just let this happen, who knows how bad it can get? Why don’t you just-
lines.zh: : 他们还能做点什么,对吧?你要愿意,我陪你一起去。可你要是就这么坐视不管,天知道会糟成什么样?你为什么不——

lines.en: : Because I’m fucking scared, okay?!
lines.zh: : 因为我他妈害怕,行吗?!

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor16
: That’s why I haven’t gone back! Am I not allowed to be scared?!
lines.zh: : 所以我才没再回去!难道我不配害怕吗?!

lines.en: : I don’t want to fucking die, Akira! Why is this happening to me?! Why now?! Everything was so good! I’m so fucking scared! I don’t know what to do!
lines.zh: : 我不想他妈死掉,Akira!为什么这种事发生在我身上?!为什么是现在?!一切都那么好!我怕得要死!我不知道该怎么办!

lines.en: : Neither do I, but I know that running away from it will only make it worse. You need to fight, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道,但我知道逃只会更糟。你得战斗,Yuki。

lines.en: : All I’ve ever done is fight! But this is...it’s different! I don’t think I...I don’t think I can win this one, Akira...I don’t know if...I just...
lines.zh: : 我这一辈子就在战斗!可这件事……不一样!我觉得我……我觉得这一场我赢不了,Akira……我不知道是不是……我只是……

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor17
: I don’t have it in me anymore...
lines.zh: : 我已经没有那个力气了……

lines.en: : If the news is bad...then what? Do they tell me how long I have? Because you might want to know, but I don’t...
lines.zh: : 如果消息很坏……那然后呢?他们会告诉我还剩多久?因为你也许想知道,但我不想……

lines.en: : I don’t want to know any of it...what’ll happen to my body...my lungs...and that’s not even mentioning my fucking brain. I’ve been smoking since I was like eleven. I don’t know how not to.
lines.zh: : 我什么都不想知道……我的身体会怎么样……我的肺……更别提我的脑子。我十一岁左右就开始抽烟了。我不会别的活法。

lines.en: : So what then? You’re just going to sit in the dark and hide from your daughter until Rika finds you dead on the floor? Is that the plan?
lines.zh: : 那然后呢?你就打算坐在黑暗里,躲着你的女儿,直到 Rika 发现你死在地板上?这就是计划?

lines.en: : There is no plan...I’m just scared...
lines.zh: : 没有什么计划……我只是怕……

lines.en: : I’m so fucking scared...I don’t want to die...
lines.zh: : 我怕得要命……我不想死……

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor18
: I don’t want to die! I can’t do this! I’ve never been this scared about ANYTHING before and I’ve had fucking GUNS pointed at me, Akira! Why were those less scary than this?!
lines.zh: : 我不想死!我做不到!我从来没对任何事这么怕过——Akira,可是有人拿枪指过我!为什么那些都没这个吓人?!

lines.en: : What if there’s nothing after this?! What if it’s just fucking...dark and...what if everything just ends?! What then?! Am I just gone?! After all of this, am I just gone?!
lines.zh: : 万一死后什么都没有呢?!万一就只是……黑暗……万一一切都就这么结束了?!然后呢?!我就这么没了?!折腾了这一切之后,我就这么没了?!

lines.en: : What good was trying to fix everything then?! What good was trying at all?!
lines.zh: : 那当初拼命挽回这一切有什么用?!当初努力过又有什么用?!

lines.en: : That’s why I’m fucking using and drinking and killing MYSELF again because it’s better for me to do it than a fucking SICKNESS, Akira! Fuck! I’m so scared! I’m so-
lines.zh: : 所以我才他妈在继续用、继续喝、继续杀死我自己——因为与其让一场疾病干掉我,还不如我自己来,Akira!操!我怕死了!我——

lines.en: : Yuki? Are you there?
lines.zh: : Yuki?你还在吗?

lines.en: : Someone’s here.
lines.zh: : 有人在这里。

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor19
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : It’s Yumi...she never left...
lines.zh: : 是 Yumi……她根本没走……

lines.en: : Oh God, she never fucking left and now she’s heard me screaming all of that shit?! What do I do now?!
lines.zh: : 天哪,她根本没走,还听到了我把那些话全部吼出来?!我现在怎么办?!

lines.en: : You hang up on me and talk to her instead. If anyone can convince you to get help, it’s her. Not me.
lines.zh: : 你挂掉我的电话,去和她谈。能劝你去求助的,只有她。不是我。

lines.en: : She’s gonna fucking hate me, Akira...more than she already does...I came back into her life just to fucking die and she’s never going to trust anyone again...it’s all my fault...
lines.zh: : 她会恨死我的,Akira……比现在还恨……我回到她的人生里,就为了死给她看,她再也不会相信任何人了……全都是我的错……

lines.en: : It’s all my fucking fault!
lines.zh: : 全都是我的错!

lines.en: : Hang up. The fucking. Phone. And answer. The door.
lines.zh: : 挂掉。电话。然后开门。

lines.en: : Can I keep you on speaker?...
lines.zh: : 我能开着免提吗?……

lines.en: : Yuki, I love you. I hope you get help. I’m hanging up now.
lines.zh: : Yuki,我爱你。希望你接受治疗。我挂了。

lines.en: : Akira, wait!
lines.zh: : Akira,等等!

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor20
: Oh god...oh no...
lines.zh: : 天哪……糟了……

lines.en: : How do I...where do I even...
lines.zh: : 我该怎么……我到底从哪开始……

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor21
: JUST GO AWAY! PLEASE! I’M SORRY FOR EVERYTHING!
lines.zh: : 滚开!求你了!对不起,一切都是我的错!

lines.en: : I’M SORRY FOR LEAVING YOU! I’M SORRY FOR BEING AN ADDICT! I’M SORRY FOR COMING BACK AND I’M SORRY FOR ABANDONING YOU AGAIN! I’M SORRY! I’M SO FUCKING-
lines.zh: : 对不起我离开了你!对不起我是个瘾君子!对不起我回来了,又对不起我再次抛弃了你!对不起!我真的他妈——

lines.en: : Aunt Yuki! Open the door! Right now!
lines.zh: : 雪姨!开门!现在!

lines.en: scene yukiatthedoor22
: ...Kaori? Is that you?...
lines.zh: : ……Kaori?是你吗?……

lines.en: : Yes, Aunt Yuki...
lines.zh: : 是,雪姨……

lines.en: : Now please...
lines.zh: : 求你了……

lines.en: scene black
: Open the door...
lines.zh: : 把门打开……
